responsibility: This machine-description fragment defines the scheduler model for the AArch64 TSV110 core. In addition to declaring the execution automaton and instruction reservations for scalar integer, load/store, multiply/divide, floating-point, NEON, and crypto operations, it introduces a TSV110-specific derived attribute that groups many AArch64 NEON instruction types into scheduler categories, allowing the backend to map the generic AArch64 instruction-type space onto TSV110’s particular functional-unit and latency model for both scalar and vector code.
